newsitem.title: USA: Total World unit files Chapter 11.
newsitem.headline: Total World unit files Chapter 11.

text.p: Total World Telecommunications Inc said Monday that its Total National Telecommunications Inc subsidiary has filed for protection and reorganization under Chapter 11 of the U.S. Bankruptcy Code, and that trading in its shares on the Nasdaq stock exchange has been halted.
The company said it plans to retain the services of a recognized work-out and restructuring company, and is in talks with several sources to obtain debtor-in-possession financing for the unit.
The company also said that chief financial officer Michael Higgins has resigned, but gave not further details.

Total World, the parent company, has not filed for bankruptcy, but said that the Nasdaq Stock Market has suspended trading of its stock until it provides the exchange with certain financial and other information.

The company said it expects to complete the filing of this information by July 31, and, if appropriate, will seek a hearing with Nasdaq to demonstrate the its continued viability and compliance with Nasdaq listing criteria.
